column1: # Provenance manifest for the committed evidence removed from this tree (REPO-1 / CP-1).
# Owner decision, 2026-09-13 (BACKLOG.md, "Owner decisions on the change plan - ANSWERS"):
#   "Delete the evidence, keep its hashes, and land REPO-2's gate that refuses evidence file
# The durable value of a log is its hash, not the 145 MB it occupies in a clone. This file
# is that value: one line per removed file, sha256 of the exact committed bytes, so any
# recovered copy can be shown to be the artefact the record refers to.
# 2026-09-13, the v0.2.1-alpha fold (merge 501d2cd3e): the 0.2.1 release line had
# committed 27 more run-output .log files under tests/ (its own wave evidence:
# 3433283 bytes). Gate 11 refused every one of them, and the same owner decision applies -
# the value of a log is its hash. Their hashes are the block appended below, in the
# same three columns; the lane reports that cite them (tests/evidence/*/REPORT.md,
# DIAGNOSIS.md, README.md) are prose and stay in the tree.
# docs/release-verification-*/ is NOT in this list: commit 3fe5addb9 had already moved the
# 22 release-verification .log files out of docs/ ("Gate 6 rejects a .log under docs/"), so
# by the time this decision was executed there were no such files left to remove.
# Verify a recovered copy (there is no `sha256sum -c` form, because the files are gone by
